content:
anna (Finance): FYI invoice from SA-Consulting arrived but our bank flagged it for withholding. Invoice lacks TRC and tax breakdown. Do we instruct bank to pay gross or proceed with withholding? Need quick decision.

samir (AP): Can we pause payment 24h and request TRC + reissued invoice showing withholding line? If vendor provides TRC we usually pay the full amount. If not, they may be short-paid.

maria (SA-Consulting): Hi all — we can provide TRC. VAT: 123456789. We didn't include tax line because previous runs were zero withholding. Happy to reissue with a tax line and attach TRC.

tess (Treasury): If bank withholds, we need the withholding code and remit instructions for SARS. Otherwise vendor will request a gross-up. Gross-ups require CFO sign-off and legal note.

li-wei (Legal): Recommend: ask vendor for TRC and a corrected invoice. If vendor cannot provide TRC within 3 business days, follow gross-up workflow only if estimated withholding >= 5% of invoice. Document agreement in the PO/invoice email thread.

payments-bot: Automated note — policy: TRC required to avoid foreign withholding. Missing TRC = invoice flagged 'wht-check'. For gross-up approval, tag finance-leads + cfo. See internal SOP: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FIN/pages/withholding-sop.

cfo-jordan (via DM to anna): I'm okay with conditional gross-up limited to actual withholding amount. Finance: record decision and route contract note to Legal.

anna (Finance): Maria, please upload TRC.pdf and reissued invoice (showing tax line) to invoices@redwood by EOD tomorrow. Samir, put a 48h hold on payment. If no TRC, we'll escalate for gross-up approval.

maria (SA-Consulting): Will do. Sending docs to anna@redwood.com now. Thanks.

anna (Finance): Received TRC. AP to proceed with gross payment once we confirm bank won't withhold. Samir, coordinate with Tess to confirm remittance path.

samir (AP): Noted. Tess, can you confirm with the bank that TRC exemption will be honored? If bank still withholds, we will follow gross-up process.

tess (Treasury): I'll follow up with bank ops and update here. Expect reply within 2 business days.

---

Vendor checklist for SA withholding avoidance:
```
- Vendor legal name and address
- South Africa VAT reg: 123456789 (if applicable)
- Tax Residency Certificate (TRC.pdf) attached
- Reissued invoice with tax breakdown or explicit 'no withholding' note
- Bank beneficiary details and SWIFT/IBAN
- Contact email for tax documentation
```

anna (Finance): tagging for follow-up. Closing thread when payment completes. :white_check_mark:
